import struct, subprocess, os, tempfile, binascii
# Build a packet-out with a guessed NXAST_ENCAP action and minimal Ethernet payload.
# We'll try a few subtype values around the likely Nicira extension range.

def pkt(subtype):
    version=6
    msg_type=13
    eth=b'\x00\x11\x22\x33\x44\x55\x66\x77\x88\x99\xaa\xbb\x08\x00' + b'\x45\x00\x00\x1c\x00\x01\x00\x00\x40\x11\x00\x00\x0a\x01\x01\x01\x0a\x01\x01\x02\x00\x35\x00\x35\x00\x08\x00\x00'
    # packet-out header: buffer_id, in_port, actions_len
    actions = struct.pack('!HHIHHIHH', 0xffffffff, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
